target_column.description: Name of the classification target column.

drop_columns.description: Comma-separated columns to exclude from features.

max_train_rows.description: Stratified cap on training rows for the initial DIMER deployment.

validation_split.description: Stratified holdout fraction when val.csv is absent.

seed.description: Random seed for splitting, sampling, and TabICL.

epochs.description: Maximum fine-tuning epochs; early stopping may stop sooner.

patience.description: Non-improving epochs tolerated before early stopping.

eval_metric.description: Validation metric used for best-checkpoint selection.

n_estimators_validation.description: Ensemble members used for end-of-epoch validation.

n_estimators_inference.description: Ensemble members used by the final fitted classifier.
